searchText: Interesting, I guess the relation is unstable due to low participation rate on ropsten which leads to delays in finality and missed slots. It should be much more stable on mainnet Hello, I joined goerli testnet 2.0 merge, but I found all method return "method eth_getFilterChanges does not exist/is not available", any pointer to solve this is highly appreciated. Ya here's the last 4h of Ropsten and Sepolia side-by-side, Sepolia looks to be a bit more stable: Assuming no empty slots and participation rate high enough to justify each epoch, the diff should be in `[64; 95]` range. 64 is after the first block in the epoch is processed, 95 is after the last one So would the fact that the diff seems to bottom out around mid-to-upper 40s instead of 64 imply that roughly 14/64 slots are empty? That might be another interesting metric to watch, do any of the CLs already capture that? I just did a quick logs scan of a ropsten teku node and in the last hour 93 of 300 slots were empty, so roughly 30% but would be interesting to have that as a metric (I didn't see it when scanning existing teku metrics) What time is Bellatrix for Prater? https://blog.ethereum.org/2022/07/27/goerli-prater-merge-announcement/ > Bellatrix, the Prater upgrade readying it for The Merge will happen at epoch 112260, expected at 12:24PM UTC on August 4, 2022. Is prater.beaconcha.in stuck? moving again now I think you want `beacon_slot{instance=~"$system"} - (beacon_finalized_epoch{instance=~"$system"} * 32)` Though that's number of slots, not number of blocks. The CL side doesn't track how many empty slots there have been recently - best you could do is how many slots since the last block.
